My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
Nuk • AI Assistant
Your item arrived damaged. According to our warranty information, you should report the damage promptly so the item can be evaluated. If the product is found to be defective after inspection, we repair or replace it at no charge. In some cases, a replacement part may be sent if it can be easily installed.
Please follow these steps:



Keep the damaged item and packaging.


Take clear photos of the damage.


Do not send anything in unless instructed.


Be prepared to share which item was damaged and describe the issue.



Once a warranty claim is processed, we will provide the next steps based on the evaluation. If applicable, you may need to ship the item to us for inspection. If it is confirmed defective, we cover the return shipment back to you.
If you would like, I can connect you with a human representative for assistance with the damaged-item process. Please let me know if you require further clarification.
